name: Qingdao Doublestar Co.,Ltd
summary: Qingdao Doublestar Co.,Ltd engages in manufacturing and sales of tires in China and internationally. The company offers passenger car tires, truck and bus tires, and giant mining tires under the NEWBUSTAR, CROSSLEADER, DOUBLESTAR, DONGFENG, and AOSEN brands. The company also offers rare earth gold tires, fully explosion-proof safety tires, ultra-wear-resistant tires, fire-resistant tires, and aircraft tires. Qingdao Doublestar Co.,Ltd was founded in 1921 and is headquartered in Qingdao, China.
